_schema: summit_county/campaign_finance vision cache v1 — COVER-PAGE STATED TOTALS ONLY (no donor itemization)
_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.
method: vision via the Read tool on a pdftoppm -jpeg -r 200 render of page 1 cropped to the top 80% ($0 API; Claude Code allotment)
notes: Typed 2022 single-total sheet ('County Coucil' typo retained). Column-order cross-check: Last Report reproduces doc 20640's Current figures (5100 / 3733.22 / 1366.78) — this INDEPENDENTLY resolves 20640's ambiguous cumulative expenditure glyph as 3733.22, but 20640's own null is left as-is (never back-filled from another document).

_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: DELTA of 1,190.00 against the cover's cumulative 5,300.00, inherited entirely from the 19 rows this filer already reported in 20640. The 3 NEW rows sum to 200.00 = the cover's current-report column exactly, so the delta is not a reading error in the new material. Cover is internally consistent (5,300.00 - 5,242.23 = 57.77 = the magnitude of its stated balance). Ledger is CUMULATIVE - it repeats 20640's 19 rows - so these rows OVERLAP the Pre-Election filing's and must never be summed across the two filings.

expenditures.detail: DELTA of 1.58 against the page's own boxed cumulative total 5,242.23, carried by the same two low-confidence cells as 20640 ('LUNCH FOR CANVASSERS' and 'REG. TRUCK FOR SUMMIT.ORG'). The post-election slice gates EXACTLY: the five rows dated 11/1/22+ sum to 1,509.01 = the printed addend and the cover's current-report figure. Ledger is CUMULATIVE - its first 22 rows are 20640's - so these rows overlap the Pre-Election filing's.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 contributions prints no total of its own; the gate is the cover's CUMULATIVE 5,300.00 and the 22 rows sum to 6,490.00 (delta 1,190.00 - the same delta the same filer's Pre-Election sheet 20640 carries on its first 19 rows). THE SECOND GATE PASSES EXACTLY: the three rows this sheet adds beyond 20640's nineteen sum to 200.00, which is the cover's CURRENT-REPORT contribution figure to the cent - so the amount column is being read correctly and the ledger is CUMULATIVE, not period-scoped. p3 expenses prints a handwritten computation above its grid: '11/1/22 [$3733.22] + 1509.01 = 12/8/22 [5242.23]'. The 27 rows sum to 5,243.81 against that 5,242.23 (delta 1.58, carried entirely by the same two doubtful cells as 20640). The five rows dated 11/1/22 and later sum to 1,509.01 exactly - which is both the printed addend and the cover's current-report expenditure figure, and which is what fixes the 'INTEGRITY / CAMPAIGN CALLS' cell at 480.00 rather than 490.00 (gate 3).

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: John 'Jack' Murphy, County Council, 2022 Post-Election. 3 pages on the county's 2022 form, same hand and same ledger as 20640 with five expense rows and three contribution rows added. THE LEDGER IS CUMULATIVE: rows 1-19 of the contribution side and rows 1-22 of the expense side are literally the same rows as the Pre-Election filing 20640, re-copied, and the cover's current-report columns are what the ADDED rows sum to (200.00 and 1,509.01, both exact). Anyone summing this filing with 20640 double-counts. ADDRESSES: not redacted and not filled in - the Mailing Address and Zipcode columns are empty for every row because the FILER left them empty (the specimen row's address survives, no erasure residue), so donor_city/donor_state are honestly blank. A hand-drawn arrow runs down the empty address column. FINDING WORTH CARRYING UPSTREAM: p3's handwritten header line resolves the module's long-standing cover ILLEGIBLE on 20640 - '[box] + 1509.01 = 5242.23' can only be satisfied by 3,733.22, so the 3738.22 alternative is excluded by arithmetic (this is independent of, and stronger than, the Last-Report column evidence already in the cache). GEOMETRY: p2's detected vertical rules are a single line, so the record supplies x/w and the 44 measured bands carry y - data rows are bands 7-28 (verified: band 28 -> '8/14/22 GOP $100--'). p3's detected rules DO span the whole table (13.6-93.9%), so the expense side is fully MEASURED with no frame at all; band 1 is the header and band 2 the specimen, so data rows are bands 3-29 (verified: band 27 -> '11/9/22 DEELICIOUS / ditto / $721.24').
